nodes.description: Public pure function G_Face(uint32 traitId_) that returns a string[2] memory tuple; selects a base64 image header/footer pair based on the traitId_ argument and returns an empty pair when no branch matches.
Function parameter traitId_ (uint32) used exclusively in a chain of equality comparisons (traitId_ == 0 ... traitId_ == 15) to select which hardcoded base64 face string is returned.
Local string variable _header holding the shared base64 prefix of the image data; concatenated with per-trait suffixes via abi.encodePacked inside string(...) conversions in every return branch.

edges.reason: The parameter traitId_ is read by the enclosing function G_Face in each equality check, so its value flows into the function's pure selection logic.
The if (traitId_ == N) conditions branch the control flow of G_Face, determining which return statement executes; no arithmetic or external interaction is involved.
The local variable _header is consumed by abi.encodePacked(_header, suffix) inside G_Face, so its value flows into the function's returned string data.

normalization_plan.reason: traitId_ is a non-core parameter whose only role is to drive the conditional return selection of the pure function G_Face; it is not tracked as a standalone security-relevant entity and should be folded into its defining function.

_header is a non-core local string constant used solely for abi.encodePacked concatenation inside G_Face; it carries no independent state or trust boundary, so it should be merged into the function node it belongs to.
